D01.text: Welcome to Shhh! Don't Wake Mom.

D02.text: Four siblings. One sleeping Mom. A whole house of chores.

D04.text: Then play solo against bot siblings, or open a room and play with a friend online.

D06.text: Press the toy chest open, and sort the blocks by colour.

D08.text: hold the plate, and scrub until it's actually clean.

D09.text: Open the fridge by its handle. Groceries go on the shelves.

D10.text: Lift the bin lid. In goes the trash.

D11.text: Hold the blanket with one hand, and rub with the other to fold it.

D12.text: Hop from room to room with a finger gun, while your siblings race you to every job.

D13.text: Your watch shows the clock, your points, and how close Mom is to waking up.

D15.text: Every clink, crash and bang wakes Mom up a little more.

D16.text: And when Mom is up, she wants a name.

D17.text: Point at a sibling. Or blame the cat.

D19.text: When the clock hits zero, the most helpful kid wins.

D21.text: Sneakily mess up a rival's job,

D23.text: Saw a sibling mess with your job? Show Mom.
